title: WIOCC Second-Floor Office Network, Security and Safety Systems
summary: Ideal Solutions delivered LAN, Wi-Fi, CCTV, access control and safety systems for WIOCC Nigeria Limited's second-floor office setup.
challenge: The second-floor office setup required several technology and building-support systems within one project, covering connectivity, surveillance, access and safety infrastructure.
solution: Delivered surveillance/CCTV and door access control systems.
Delivered network LAN and Wi-Fi infrastructure for the office setup.
Delivered an addressable fire alarm system.
Delivered earthing and grounding, together with lightning and thunder arrestor systems.
result: The project brought multiple technology and safety systems into a single office setup. The documented delivery covered connectivity, electronic security, fire detection and supporting protection systems.

title: Paxton Access Control Installation for Open Access Data Centres
summary: Ideal Solutions installed an access control system for OADC, including Paxton Net2 controllers, readers, electromagnetic locks and supporting cabling.
challenge: OADC required an access control installation across its facility, with door-control equipment, power supplies, emergency release components and supporting infrastructure.
solution: Installed Paxton Net2 access-control controllers and Paxton keypad/proximity readers.
Installed electromagnetic locks and power supply units with backup batteries.
Installed exit buttons, emergency break-glass units and emergency override switches.
Completed access-control cabling, power cabling and associated civil works.
result: The installation covered electronic access control and its supporting infrastructure within a data-centre environment, including normal door operation and emergency release components.

Deinstalled and decommissioned data-centre equipment.
